title: SKIP_STEP / workflow guard: cancel endpoint may accept a second request after the order already reached the terminal 'canceled' state
unsupported_reason: The hypothesis is that the server should reject (e.g. 4xx, or a no-op response with orderStatus unchanged) a second POST /api/order/cancel once order.orderStatus is already 'canceled' and order.availableActions.cancelOrder is already false — a workflow-state/status-equality guard, not a numeric amount comparison. sum_lte cannot express 'the second call must be rejected' or 'orderStatus must remain exactly canceled without re-processing'. The resulting financial impact of this same missing guard, if any, is separately covered by the amount_bound double-cancel scenario (01_double_cancel_amount_bound.plan.json).
